name: Madness in Bloom
source:
When your quiet life falls apart, you don’t stay to pick up the pieces.
You leave.
A remote cabin, far from everything familiar, becomes your temporary refuge.
One week. No distractions. Just silence, nature… and the unknown.
Sometimes, leaving everything behind is only the beginning.

[From [url=https://quill-studio.itch.io/madness-in-bloom]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你平静的生活崩溃时，你不会留下来收拾残局。
你离开。
远离熟悉的一切的偏远小屋成为你的临时避难所。
一周。没有干扰。只有寂静、自然……和未知。
有时候，抛开一切只是一个开始。

[来自[url=https://quill-studio.itch.io/madness-in-bloom]itch.io[/url]]
